title: AnvilOrder
description: This mod adds IAmCal's Enchantment Ordering tool directly into the anvil interface ingame. Huge thank you to him, this project would not have been possible without his work.
body:
AnvilOrder is a Fabric mod that solves a problem many people have dealt with before. When combining tools, weapons and pieces of armor with enchanted books out of your villager trading hall, it get really expensive really fast or it just won't let you combine at all. 
IAmCal solved this problem with his project [Enchant Order](https://iamcal.github.io/enchant-order/). It's basically the standard for anyone trying to enchant. The problem is that it requires you to go to your web browser, there is no tool to use it ingame. That can be frustrating, especially with single monitor setups. That's why I took the project and added it directly into the anvils interface.
To use it, put an unenchanted item in the left anvil slot and click on the new button the the right. Then chose then enchantments you want to add. After clicking calculate, you get the instructions on the right side.

This mod has been ported back from 26.2 to 26.1.x and 1.21.x. I don't plan to go further back, if you want an older version, please open a pull request so I can review the changes. Same for Snapshots.
In the 1.21.x versions, the UI is a bit broken. Everything still works just fine tho!
